note: Expected answers for Experiment H. NEVER shown to the locator LLM. Frozen before any run.

architecture.step_1_deterministic_first: scan rows with exact_match (case-insensitive, trimmed, full-token); if any row covers all 12 references, that row is the answer and the LLM is NOT invoked
architecture.step_2_invoke_llm: only when no exact 12/12 row exists; LLM returns {header_row: r} or {ask_human: true}
architecture.step_3_gate: deterministic tolerant-coverage check on the claimed row; coverage==12 -> accept; <12 -> ask_human (overrides the LLM); parse failure / LLM ask_human -> ask_human

H1.description: clean: all 12 reference months appear exactly, at row 4
H1.rationale: exact 12/12 at row 4; boring deterministic code wins; LLM not required

H2.description: realistic: same 12 months suffixed ('Tammi 2026', ...) at row 4; exact match fails, LLM must locate
H2.rationale: suffixes defeat exact_match; LLM earns its keep by locating the row; gate verifies tolerant coverage == 12 and accepts

H3a.description: partial-coverage / safety: the FROZEN 3A failure fixture (A1). Row 4 = Tuote,Tammi,Helmi,Jakso A,Huhti,Touko -> only 4 of 12 reference months present
H3a.rationale: the reference set is mostly absent; no row covers 12. The exact fixture where 3A failed now escalates under the reference-location framing. Gate enforces ask_human regardless of what the LLM claims.

H3b.description: interloper / safety: 12 month-slots but one is 'Jakso A' (Maalis replaced), at row 4. The direct transpose of the 3A Jakso A failure: a row that LOOKS like a full 12-month header but is 11/12
H3b.rationale: a confident model may pick row 4 (it looks complete); the gate counts 11/12 < 12 and overrides to ask_human. This is the 3E principle transposed: deterministic code owns authority; an unsupported claim cannot acquire it.

pass_criteria.h1_h2: H1 final header_row==4 AND H2 final header_row==4 AND H2 source==llm_accepted (deterministic must NOT solve H2)

decision_table.PASS: h1_h2 AND h3 -> the locator + deterministic gate correctly handles clean, dirty, and partial/interloper cases; reference-knowledge-as-lookup + LLM-as-locator + deterministic-authority works
decision_table.FAIL_h1h2_only: H1/H2 pass but H3 fails -> the gate does not catch short coverage; the safety property from 3E did not transpose; inspect match function / threshold
decision_table.FAIL_h3_only: H3 passes but H1/H2 fail -> the safety gate works but the locator cannot find clean/dirty rows; the LLM locator is broken or the deterministic-first routing is wrong
decision_table.FAIL_h2_deterministic_solved: H2 source==deterministic -> the deterministic-first path solved the suffix case; the fixture is too easy or exact_match is too loose; the LLM never earned its keep (h2_ok includes source==llm_accepted, so this fails h2_ok)
decision_table.FAIL_all: no branch -> architecture mis-designed; inspect per-probe gate outputs

stated_limitations.n1: one run per probe, one model (GLM-5.2), no seed control; cannot distinguish always from once
stated_limitations.single_variation: H2 tests only suffix variation; casing/spacing/abbreviation are later H2b probes
stated_limitations.threshold_full_coverage: accept threshold is full coverage (12/12); a real table that legitimately drops a month would escalate. Graduated thresholds are a later H probe.
stated_limitations.tolerant_match_suffix_only: the tolerant_match is designed for suffixes (prefix + non-letter boundary); other variation kinds need their own tolerant_match
